SELECT r.id,COALESCE(e.name,u.name) respondentName,r.answers_json,r.created_at submittedAt FROM training_survey_response r LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id=r.user_id LEFT JOIN organization_employee e ON e.id=r.employee_id WHERE r.training_id=#{trainingId} ORDER BY r.id DESC

SELECT v.id,v.title,COALESCE(p.position_seconds,0) positionSeconds,COALESCE(p.completed,false) completed FROM training_video v LEFT JOIN training_video_progress p ON p.video_id=v.id AND p.user_id=#{userId} WHERE v.training_id=#{trainingId} ORDER BY v.sort_order,v.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training_video_progress(video_id,user_id,position_seconds,completed) VALUES(#{videoId},#{userId},#{position},#{completed}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE position_seconds=VALUES(position_seconds),completed=completed OR VALUES(completed)
